scenes.name: act1_lego_alarm_approach
scenes.text: Critical alert on the brick grid! Server Blade zero-one connection pool crashed. Autonomous LEGO agent dispatched to station one.

scenes.name: act2_lego_scan_server
scenes.text: Scanning hardware. Memory leak detected in brick cluster. Snapping in a hotfix brick. Daemon rebooted, status solid cyan!

scenes.name: act3_lego_console_tests
scenes.text: Waddling over to the cyber slope terminal. Rapid-fire typing with C-clamp hands. All forty-two regression unit tests pass!

scenes.name: act4_lego_lever_deploy
scenes.text: Approaching the Technic master deployment lever. Locking yellow grip into place, pulling down. Hundred percent power locked in!

scenes.name: act5_lego_victory_ship
scenes.text: Autonomous code shipped to production while humans sleep. Build your own AI brick workforce. Subscribe for more agentic workflows!
